source_attribution: Archive README attributes the panel to LiteTransformerSearch (NeurIPS 2022), used in the NSC GPT-2 benchmark experiment. Upstream per-run provenance has not been independently reconstructed.
transformations: Preserve all architecture configurations and reported parameter fields. Separate 100 development validation-PPL labels and 100 final test-PPL labels. Assign architectures within each width by SHA-256 of a fixed prefix plus canonical JSON; no outcomes used. Omit unused labels.
limitations: Single recorded endpoint per architecture; seeds, training tokens, exact training code revision and hardware are absent.
Archive calls this a GPT-2/Transformer-XL panel. Configurations contain memory and adaptive-embedding fields. Do not relabel it as a modern pre-normalized GPT decoder.
No trained labels for synthetic reorderings, MoE, GQA/MLA, loops or hyperconnections.
Final labels are held out by course protocol, not access control. Do not inspect or tune on them before freezing the method.
